corrections.reason: Joining with the previous line ዘየኃ↵ሥዉ, the plural subject አይሁድ requires the 3rd person masculine plural verb ዘየኃሥዉ ('whom the Jews seek to kill', John 7:25). Visually, ዉ is clearly printed after ሥ.
Amharic relative clause translating እምሰብአ ኢየሩሳሌም ('from the people who are in Jerusalem'): በኢየሩሳሌም ካሉ ሰዎች ወገን. Visually, the shortened right leg of ካ (4th order) is clear.

In Classical Ge'ez (quoting 4 Ezra / ዕዝራ ሱቱኤል), the direct object of ወርኢኩ ('and I saw') takes the accusative 4th order: ዓቢየ ነፋሰ ('a great wind'). Visually, both የ and ሰ are 1st-order/4th-order glyphs without the 6th-order hooks of ይ/ስ.
